sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Commencing Echo Route. Welfare check completed along Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check completed along McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City Shopping Centre, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check completed along Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full scope of the location, no visible concerns identified, all clear. Standing by for response calls while ensuring a strong security presence.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; location scoped out thoroughly, all clear.
Welfare check along Rutland Street and Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks along the water fountain and Lorne Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at the intersection of Lorne Street and High Street.
Commencing welfare checks along High Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Women's Memorial Hall; no issues present, a few street vagrants slowly getting up.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full sweep within the vicinity, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible and known while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols, no visible problems identified.
Quick scope of Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in; welfare checks commenced on the static guards and all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to maintain a strong security presence.

Arrived at the check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks completed along all stores and businesses within the area, no issues found or reported. Standing by for response calls while maintaining a strong visible presence in the area.
Continuing patrols and moving forward to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in, the last checkpoint for Echo Route; welfare checks commenced along all stores in the area. Ending Echo Route.
Commencing Alpha + Charlie Route. Welfare checks along Queens Arcade, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed on the ground floor and Level 1 break area, all clear.

Welfare check along McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed within the location with welfare checks along all stores and businesses in the area, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols with no concerns identified.
Response call from The Receptionist Cafe reporting an aggressive vagrant threatening staff members; as the individual was leaving, he kicked one of their store signs.

Response call from The Right Track, Fort Street, reporting an aggressive group of vagrants consuming alcohol outside on their benches and tables; the alcohol was not purchased from the business. The team split up to attend both response calls.
Arrived at The Right Track response location; the group of vagrants had already moved along.

Arrived at The Receptionist Cafe response location; as the individual had been verbally and physically aggressive, we remained stationed in case he returned. Photo description retrieved. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.

Continuing patrols; a strong presence was maintained and the individual did not return. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence while keeping a lookout for any vagrants causing trouble.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Customs Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the corner of Albert Street and Customs Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Federal Square and the Cathedral church, no issues found.
Response call from The Receptionist Cafe reporting a group of vagrants being loud, last seen making their way up Queen Street.
Response message from Management reporting an aggressive group of vagrants consuming alcohol on the benches on Vulcan Lane.

Arrived at the response location; notified the group of vagrants that they cannot consume alcohol as the Auckland CBD is a liquor-ban area. They complied without further issues and were last seen boarding the red public transport bus. Continuing patrols up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.

During the welfare check at Ippondo, asked two street vagrants to move away from the front of the store and advised them not to sit there, as the business complains about individuals sitting in front of their glass window. Both individuals complied without an issue.
Welfare check inside Metro Entertainment City; walkthrough within the vicinity, no issues found.
Welfare check along Jacks Fried Chicken and Cafe, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full sweep commenced around the location, no issues found. Standing by to maintain a strong security presence.

Arrived at the check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; area thoroughly cleared of any issues. Patrolling down Queen Street to ensure a strong security presence while making our way back to HQ for lunch break.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Response call from Lumi Cafe reporting a group of street vagrants sitting on their tables and chairs right next to the store; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at the response location; asked the group of vagrants to move along, and they complied without further issues. Standing by to show presence before continuing to HQ.
Response call from Roma Blooms reporting a group of street vagrants congregating at the front of their store on the public benches consuming alcohol.

Arrived at the response location and spoke with the individuals reported. They admitted to having alcohol in their bags; we advised them not to drink in public as it is a liquor-ban area, and they complied and agreed. Continuing to stand by to ensure our presence is visible.
Continuing patrols back down Queen Street.
Response call from Lumi Cafe reporting the same group of vagrants sitting next to their store, requesting assistance to move them along once again.

Response call from Roma Blooms reporting more individuals congregating at the public benches. Reviewed the cameras and will monitor for further issues; the individuals are currently just sitting and talking.
Arrived at the Lumi Cafe response location; woke the individuals and asked them to move along once again, advising them not to return or a verbal trespass will be issued.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift while awaiting further response calls.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
The second guard for the Afternoon Shift is running 30 minutes late; standing by until he arrives before commencing routes and patrols.
Second guard has not yet arrived; commencing patrols single-guard until they arrive. Commencing Alpha Route.
Response call from 233 Queen Street reporting a male individual yelling in front of the store.
Arrived at 233 Queen Street; the male individual had left the premises. Standing by for security presence in case he returns.
Arrived at HQ for guard changeover.

Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare checks on stores along Queen Street between HQ and McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, nothing reported. Standing by for security presence for the surrounding businesses and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Response call from Localito regarding a vagrant who had vomited outside their store; assistance requested.
Arrived at Localito; the vagrant had left the premises. Staff members on break informed us it was a female vagrant. Standing by.
Leaving the standby area; no issues have occurred.
Arrived at Aotea Square; standing by for security presence and conducting welfare checks on stores.

Response call from Kathmandu regarding a female and a male individual who stole from their store. Description: both wearing grey tracksuits, the female with a white t-shirt underneath; stolen items are puffer jackets; no direction of travel given. Informed Kathmandu staff we would look for them while making our way down. Departing the standby area and heading down Queen Street.
Arrived at Kathmandu to retrieve photos of the female and male individuals.

Pictures of the individuals received. (Photos on file.) Informed the store manager we will keep an eye out while patrolling and, if found, all stolen items will be retrieved. Commencing patrols down to TK Square.

Arrived at TK Square; welfare checks on stores along Queen Street between Kathmandu and TK Square, nothing reported. Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street and surrounding stores, no issues reported. Standing by at TK Square for security presence and on the lookout for problematic issues and the individuals from Kathmandu.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred and no sighting of the individuals from Kathmandu.
Arrived at the Fort Street check-in; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear, nothing reported.
Welfare checks on stores along Fort Street, Commerce Street and Gore Street; all clear, no issues reported. Standing by on Fort Street.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls received.
Arrived at the Chancery Square / Freyberg Square check-in, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Arrived at HQ; quick toilet break before commencing floor checks.
Floor checks complete; gearing up to commence patrols.
Response call from Bao and Noodle, Lorne Street, regarding a male who appeared to be intoxicated, had gone into their restrooms and fallen asleep.
Response call from Cotton On Queen Street regarding two minors who stole from their store, last seen heading up to High Street.

Arrived at Bao and Noodle, Lorne Street; informed the male he had to depart the premises as requested by the store manager. He was compliant; helped him gather his belongings and accompanied him out of the premises.
The male has been successfully removed from the premises with no issues to report.
Commencing patrols to look for the two minors who stole from Cotton On.
Arrived at the bottom of Queen Street at the corner of Customs Street; the two female minors from Cotton On have been spotted.
Stolen items retrieved from the minors who stole from Cotton On; heading back to Cotton On to return the stolen items.
Arrived at Cotton On; stolen items returned and staff are happy. Commencing patrols.

Arrived at TK Square; returned to the area as the two female minors who stole from Cotton On were still nearby. Standing by at TK Square on the lookout for any problematic issues that may occur within the area.
Response call from Right Track, Fort Street, regarding a male disturbing their customers; assistance requested to move him along.

Arrived at Right Track, Fort Street; the manager pointed out the individual. We approached the male and informed him he had to leave; he complied and left the premises with no issues. Standing by in case he decides to return.
Leaving the standby area; no sighting of the individual moved along. Heading back to HQ to let Hasi into the office.
Leaving the standby area and heading up Queen Street.

Arrived at Aotea Square; standing by for any nearby response calls, providing security presence for members of the public and surrounding businesses, and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on stores within the area.
Welfare checks on the stores still open within the area complete; no issues reported. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Heading back to HQ to give Hasi access into HQ.
Arrived at the High Street check-in, all clear.
Arrived at the Freyberg Square / Chancery Square check-in, all clear; stores have nothing to report. Standing by for security presence for restaurant customers.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Afternoon shift concluded. Auror reports have been processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief with the Afternoon Shift completed; charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (23:00–23:35).
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear. Arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep.
Full sweep of Britomart complete; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear; welfare check at Reign & Pour, all clear. Arrived at the Viaduct, patrolling the area.
Viaduct all clear; arrived at Danny Doolans, maintaining presence in the area.
Welfare check at Danny Doolans, all clear. Patrolling through Customs Street to Albert Street.
Customs Street all clear; patrolling Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear.
Welfare check along Albert Street, all clear. Arrived at Ace Karaoke; large crowd in the area, maintaining presence.
Heavy Police presence in the area due to an incident that occurred at Hotel Indigo; maintaining presence for any issues.
Maintaining presence at Ace Karaoke Bar (01:38–02:35).
Arrived at Federal Square; commencing a sweep of the area.

Full sweep of Federal Square complete; welfare checks at the Cathedral area, Liston House and Hotel Indigo, all clear. Received a message from a fellow guard at Ace Karaoke to come and stand by due to suspected trouble inside the premises.
Maintaining presence outside Ace Karaoke until the crowd inside clears out.
Standing down from Ace Karaoke Bar as it has closed; continuing patrols through Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Square complete; patrolling down Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Victoria Street; welfare checks at Skymart Convenience Store, 77 Convenience Store and Domino's, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place complete; welfare checks along Chancery Street and O'Connell Street, all clear. Continuing down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of High Street, all clear; patrolling Fort Lane.
Welfare check along Shortland Street, all clear.
Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare checks at Jo & Joes and the Fort Street Wilson Carpark, all clear. Patrolling to Britomart.
Welfare check at Customs Convenience Store.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep.
Full sweep of Britomart complete; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (04:48–05:15).
Commencing a 30-minute break, responding to any calls that occur (on break 05:40–05:50).
On standby in the office awaiting guard handover.
Night shift completed. Changeover to the Morning Shift.

flags: CAPACITY: 12:21 Response call from The Receptionist Cafe (loud vagrant group) has no attendance entry logged — the group had already moved up Queen Street when reported.

CAPACITY: 18:20 Cotton On theft call received while the team was attending the Bao and Noodle removal; search for the minors commenced at 18:35 after the first call was resolved (stolen items recovered 18:55).
CAPACITY: 14:35–15:25 Afternoon Shift ran single-guard — second guard arrived ~50 minutes late; changeover completed 15:25.
SENSITIVE: 00:49 routine Night Shift welfare check at Reign & Pour (Quay Street/Viaduct) — all clear, no incident or use of force; noted only because of the separate Reign & Pour matter.

capacity.note: No attendance entry recorded; group reported already gone.
Held behind the Bao & Noodle removal; items recovered 18:55.
